Impact Credit Consultants is a consumer financial help resource listed in the CreditDoc directory. The company's website was not reachable during our review, so we could not independently confirm current products, pricing, licensing status, or operating hours. This profile page exists so consumers researching Impact Credit Consultants can find the contact record on CreditDoc.

Because we could not verify the site, this page does not describe specific loan products, rates, or service details. Consumers considering Impact Credit Consultants should contact the company directly to confirm what services are currently offered and at what cost, and to request written disclosures for any product before signing.

For nonprofit consumer credit counseling, verify membership in NFCC (nfcc.org) or FCAA (fcaa.org). For legal aid, check the LSC-funded provider directory (lsc.gov) for your state.
